name: figure-to-svg
description: Replicate raster figures as clean, editable SVGs. Default mode embeds icons as transparent PNGs (fast, faithful); pass 'svg' to hand-vectorize each icon for full editability. Two skills: figure-to-svg (whole infographic -> master SVG via split/regenerate/slice/compose + fresh-eyes review loop; also the lesson/feedback/digest knowledge verbs) and icon-to-svg (one icon image -> faithful hand-authored vector, used in svg mode). Use to adapt figures for papers and slides so wording, colors, and layout stay editable in PowerPoint via Insert SVG -> Convert to Shape.
